title: Grateful Dead Live at Meramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard plagued by speed and pitch fluctuations, yet a solid three‑set show highlighted by Candyman, Rider, Speedway slide and a great Jordan jam.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture suffers from noticeable wow, speed inconsistencies and occasional out‑of‑tune guitars, making the listening experience uneven. Musically the concert is an average‑to‑above‑average early‑’70 performance with standout moments such as Candyman’s sparse arrangement, a crisp Rider, a nice Jerry slide on Speedway and a spirited Jordan jam, while other numbers feel merely adequate.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give divergent impressions – one 5‑star rave, one detailed 3‑star critique pointing to recording flaws and an average show. Weighted assessment yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fluctuating speed and pitch issues throughout the second set; occasional tape wow (Not Fade Away) and out‑of‑tune guitars; a reel‑change cut in Schoolgirl; overall sound is usable but uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set structure with a brief acoustic first set, a long NRPS intermission and an extensive second electric set; the pacing is uneven but includes several memorable jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for a nice slide at the end of Speedway and generally solid playing.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey does not appear on the acoustic set due to alternating duties with Billy.
